nodes.title: DeepSeek Harness Service Model
nodes.summary: Official sources describe plugin-based models, tools, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops and UI. This proves reference capabilities, not Brew compatibility.

nodes.title: Brew Compatibility Audit
nodes.summary: Provider, tools, sessions, receipts and UI all require adapters. Workspace confinement must remain Brew-owned; equivalent approval governance was not verified.

nodes.title: Preserve Brew Runtime Authority
nodes.summary: Brew remains authority for workspace identity, confinement, policy, approvals, governed execution and chained receipts.

nodes.title: Governed Brew-Style Harness Task
nodes.summary: Harness was not installed locally and no governed Brew-style task was run. Adoption cannot advance without executable integration evidence.

nodes.title: Harness Adoption
nodes.summary: Do not adopt or replace Brew runtime yet. Approval enforcement, confinement, receipt compatibility, restart identity and truthful UI projection remain unproven.
